Slanted Magazine #46—Cairo

2025

About This Issue

Slanted Magazine #46—Cairo is a visual journey into the vibrant heart of Egypt's creative scene. This issue showcases outstanding projects across graphic design, typography, visual communication, architecture, and product design that are shaping the cultural present and future of the region.

The magazine features work from designers, illustrators, and artists based in Cairo, other Egyptian cities, and internationally. It includes in-depth essays and articles on cultural, social, and creative topics related to Cairo and Egypt.

The design features radiant sandy hues and bright pink accents with classic yet modern pyramid motifs finished with hot foil embossing.

Special Notes

A limited Special Edition includes five stunning photo prints by photographer Markus Lange. The issue also features a hoodie collaboration with Reell and Negmedine Khaled, and a special short film "Cairo Unscripted—Exploring Cairo's Past, Present, and Creative Future" by design studio Ntsal.
